summary: Giải pháp cung cấp bộ nhớ dài hạn cho các CLI agent coding, hỗ trợ handoff giữa các vendor agent khác nhau.
usecases: Persist working context for CLI agents across sessions
Enable vendor-agnostic handoff between different agent frameworks
Integrate into automation systems to maintain long-term state
ideas: Combine with popular agent frameworks like AutoGPT for continuous memory experience
Develop IDE plugins for automatic project state save and restore
Create a visual memory management interface for agent review and editing
